description:
Verify every CLI/storage/structure/semantics claim in `docs/concepts/` against current source and fix all drift class-wide.

## Background

`docs/concepts/` (9 files — `containment-and-completion.md`, `core-model.md`, `design-philosophy.md`, `guarantees.md`, `hierarchy-resolution.md`, `overview.md`, `planning-bracket.md`, `scope.md`, `validation-engine.md`; 3,339 lines) is one of the disjoint-footprint areas in an exhaustive, source-verified documentation audit covering the whole adopter-facing documentation surface. A prior sampling-based review already caught real drift in this repository's docs but never covered this area exhaustively. Recurring drift classes to sweep for include invented CLI surface, stale storage-format specifics, over-credited guarantees, legacy or future narration, and prerequisite/environment drift.

Two live drift instances are already known and must be fixed as part of this work: `guarantees.md:85-97` names the wrong claim-lock filename, internally inconsistent with the correct name given at `guarantees.md:355-366`; and `guarantees.md:170` cites the event type `IssueUpdated`, a value that matches zero real events in the event log. These are seeds, not the full defect set — sweeping the entire footprint for every instance of each drift class found is this work's job.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every documented command and flag in `docs/concepts/` exists in the current generated CLI schema or the current clap definitions.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every repository-relative link, heading anchor, source citation, and addressable-item citation in `docs/concepts/` resolves.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every diagram-shaped block in `docs/concepts/` is Mermaid; directory trees and verbatim command output are not diagrams.
- [hard] REQ-04: Every factual claim in `docs/concepts/` about CLI behavior, storage layout, repository structure, or engine semantics matches the current source tree; where a drift instance is found, its whole class is swept across the footprint, not patched line-by-line.
- [hard] REQ-05: Prose in `docs/concepts/` states current behavior only — no legacy or future/roadmap narration remains.
- [hard] REQ-06: Every volatile fact in `docs/concepts/` with an existing projection or citation surface is projected or cited rather than hand-copied; each volatile fact with no such surface is cited to its source file and recorded for follow-up filing.
- [hard] REQ-07: `guarantees.md:85-97`'s claim-lock filename matches the name given at `guarantees.md:355-366`, and both agree with the actual filename used in source.
- [hard] REQ-08: `guarantees.md:170`'s event-type example cites a real event tag that appears in the actual event log, not `IssueUpdated`.

## Notes

The linked plan document carries the exact check commands and expected outputs (§2).

CLI-surface verification must use a binary built from the current HEAD; a stale installed binary has previously produced false verification results. The generated CLI schema under-reports the real flag surface (clap `visible_alias` flag forms and the global flags are absent from it), so a documented flag absent from the schema is checked against the clap definitions in `crates/jit/src/cli.rs` before being declared invented; only a flag absent from both is a defect.

Known-benign box-drawing content in this footprint: `overview.md:92-100` and `guarantees.md:357-366` are directory-tree/verbatim-output listings, not diagrams.

**State-enum citation caveat:** the generated CLI schema's `State` enum is missing the `rejected` value (a known, open engine defect, tracked separately). State-enum facts in this footprint cite `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:28-42` (or `docs/reference/storage-format.md`), never the schema's types map, until that defect is fixed.

A doc in this footprint found wholly obsolete or redundant may be deleted or merged into another, with the rationale recorded on this task. Every inbound link tree-wide is repointed in the same change — links are uniformly relative markdown, so inbound references are findable by filename in both bare-name and relative-path forms — and no doc is removed before its inbound links are repointed. After any deletion or merge, every link and anchor tree-wide still resolves.

Blast radius: self-contained to `docs/concepts/` unless a delete/merge triggers the rule above.
title: Concepts documentation audit
